description:
Propose one of your advertised skills for the shared skill library.

Bourdon reads the skill from the folder your own skill reader advertised (never a path you pass), checks that it is text-only, and snapshots it into a pending proposal, so editing the folder later does not change what gets approved. A person approves or rejects it at a terminal (`bourdon skills approve`); no tool approves a proposal.

`content_sha256` picks one advertised copy when you advertise more than one skill with this name. `source_agent` is honoured for the local operator only; every other caller proposes its own skills. Pending proposals appear in `list_skills` as `tier: proposed`.
name: propose_skill
title: Propose skill
